article.title: Saving of provisions of Indian Succession Act relating to wills
article.content:
103Saving of provisions of Indian Succession Act relating to wills

Section 103 · Part III · Chapter VI
Nothing in this Chapter shall be taken to affect any of the provisions of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 (39 of 1925) as to the construction of wills.
